limits: No runtime qualification from static review; actual native gates/build/verifier/acceptance are separate mandatory checks.
Fixed toy refactors demonstrate bounded transport/evolution plumbing, not general task usefulness or broad behavior preservation.
Case inventories assert streams/exits, not absence of side effects. Evaluator must enforce/observe effects independently.
Run under a specifically pinned shell with builtin printf/test. POSIX source portability does not by itself attest runtime builtin placement.
Stdin is empty in these vectors; NUL is not a representable argv string; OS/runtime identities and authority remain separate.
logical_reasoning: All scripts gate arity before positional access; case dispatch or short-circuit AND guards prevent set-u errors for zero arguments.
Literal quoted case keys allow only alpha/beta/gamma and exact lookup/list modes; all unknown/Unicode/metacharacter/whitespace arguments select usage.
Functions only emit constant literal values using builtin printf; list order remains alpha/beta/gamma; usage stderr newline and exit2 preserved.
Changes reorder disjoint lookup branches and function definitions, substitute equivalent emit parameter-default syntax, and replace arity case with equivalent short-circuit if conditions.
Both sealed initial sources byte-equal declared final20; only explicit extension obligations alter corresponding baseline-invalid rows.
scope: Read-only logical review after independent oracle files frozen; no source execution or model input/output inspection.
